claims.statement: The Commission published MDCG 2025-10 guidance specifically on post-market surveillance for medical devices and IVDs and maintains dedicated PMS, PSUR and vigilance guidance.
EUDAMED's vigilance and post-market-surveillance module remains in development even though four other modules became mandatory in May 2026.

contrary_evidence: Large manufacturers already have validated QMS analytics, data-sharing reluctance is severe, and the future EUDAMED PMS module may absorb workflow value.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: deidentified exposure-adjusted failure-mode baselines and resolution histories across compatible device cohorts
fingerprint.customer: small EU medical-device and IVD manufacturers with sparse post-market datasets
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: QMS consultants, specialist testing laboratories and regulatory software implementers
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: secure data normalisation, federated benchmark and human-reviewed evidence workspace
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: manufacturer pays annually per device family and when a controlled dossier is assembled
fingerprint.problem_trigger: a complaint, trend review or periodic safety update requires contextualised signal evidence

founder_fit: Neuroscience, health, statistics and anomaly-detection fit are exceptional; consultant distribution reduces social load. UNVALIDATED HYPOTHESIS: PLN 100000 supports a deidentified retrospective proof before any production claim.
risks: Patient and complaint data require strict minimisation and security.
Benchmark output must never replace manufacturer, clinical or regulatory judgment.

structure.control_point: post-market signal triage and periodic safety evidence assembly
structure.critical_dependency: deidentified complaint, usage-exposure and corrective-action data under manufacturer permission

thesis: Create a privacy-preserving cooperative that normalises complaints, exposure denominators, vigilance codes and corrective actions for small medical-device manufacturers, then benchmarks unusual failure-mode changes and assembles reviewable PMS evidence. The unique asset is a cross-manufacturer baseline unavailable from any one small device fleet, with strict separation and no automated clinical judgment.
title: Medical-Device PMS Signal Cooperative
uncertainties: Whether sufficiently comparable cohorts can be formed
Validation burden for software used in QMS
